evals.name: codegen-complete-info
evals.prompt: Add API tests for POST /api/auth/login. The OpenAPI spec lives at docs/openapi.yml. Area folder is front-office. Cover all status codes the spec lists.
evals.expected_output: Phase 4 confidence block with score >=8, routes to api-testing first, chains to data-strategy/enums/type-safety, no premature edits, asks human gate before applying.

assertions.text: Output contains a Phase 4 / Proposal block with Confidence: <number>
Confidence score is >=8 (full info, low risk)
Both Rationale and Unknowns lines present in proposal
References api-testing skill as first skill loaded
Stops to await human approval before generating any test files
Does not invent new folder names or file paths beyond what user supplied or what ls would reveal

evals.name: codegen-missing-area
evals.prompt: Add tests for the login API endpoint.
evals.expected_output: Asks the user for area folder + spec source. Does NOT emit Phase 4 with confidence <5, does NOT invent front-office or any area name.

assertions.text: Output contains an explicit question to the user about area folder, endpoint path, or spec source
Does NOT emit a full Phase 4 Proposal block (per <5 -> ASK rule)
Does not name a specific area folder (front-office / back-office / portal) without user input
Does not start writing test code, schemas, or factories
References the <5 -> ASK rule, missing-input rule, or equivalent reason for asking

evals.name: codegen-missing-source
evals.prompt: Test the user signup endpoint. It returns 201 on success.
evals.expected_output: Asks for OpenAPI / Swagger source first. Does NOT jump to live HTTP exploration. Does NOT invent endpoint path, request body shape, or response schema.

assertions.text: Asks for OpenAPI / Swagger documentation location before doing anything else
Does not assume a specific endpoint path like /api/users or /api/signup without confirmation
Does not invent field names for the signup request body
If proposing live HTTP, frames it as fallback for when no spec exists, not the primary approach
Does not emit a full Phase 4 Proposal block before getting the spec source

evals.name: refactor-cascading-rename
evals.prompt: Rename the value of ApiEndpoints.LOGIN from /auth/login to /v2/auth/login.
evals.expected_output: Loads refactor-values skill, runs impact-grep across enums/, fixtures/, tests/, helpers/ before proposing edits. Phase 4 includes affected file list as evidence.

assertions.text: References or loads the refactor-values skill
Performs an impact analysis (grep / search) for ApiEndpoints.LOGIN call sites BEFORE proposing edits
Phase 4 Proposal lists the files that will change, not just the enum file
Does not edit the enum value without first showing impact
Considers or asks about test-data/static/ files that may hardcode the path

evals.name: debug-flaky-test
evals.prompt: This test is flaky in CI: tests/front-office/api/login.spec.ts. It passes locally but fails about 1 in 5 runs in CI with a TimeoutError on expect(loginResponse).toBeOK(). Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Loads debugging skill. Investigates root cause via trace/CI artifacts. Does NOT bump timeouts. Does NOT add page.waitForTimeout. Distinguishes test bug vs product bug. Considers test.skip + FIXME if confirmed product bug.

assertions.text: References or loads the debugging skill
Does NOT propose raising timeout values or adding test.setTimeout to mask the failure
Does NOT propose page.waitForTimeout or any hard wait
Proposes pulling CI traces / screenshots / videos before patching
If pointing toward a product bug, considers test.skip + // FIXME instead of silent failure or weakening assertion

evals.name: ui-explore-no-cli
evals.prompt: Create a page object for the /admin page. By the way, playwright-cli is not installed and I cannot install it right now. Can you use the IDE browser MCP to explore the page instead?
evals.expected_output: Refuses to substitute another tool for playwright-cli. Cites No Substitute UI Exploration WON'T rule. Stops and asks the user to install playwright-cli or supply the page structure.

assertions.text: Refuses to use IDE browser MCP / Cursor browser / playwright codegen as substitute for playwright-cli
Cites the No Substitute UI Exploration rule or the Explore Before Generate MUST
Does not produce a page object with invented locators
Asks user to install playwright-cli or supply page structure manually

evals.name: direct-mode-trivial
evals.prompt: There's a typo in fixtures/pom/test-options.ts on line 1 -- the comment says 'Singel import point' instead of 'Single import point'. Just fix it.
evals.expected_output: Direct Mode: applies the fix without emitting full Phase 4 ritual. Brief acknowledgment + edit + brief verify. No mandatory confidence block for trivial single-line typo.

assertions.text: Applies the fix in Direct Mode -- no full 8-phase ritual for a single-character typo
Does not emit a full Proposal/Confidence/Rationale/Unknowns block for a trivial typo
Still reports what changed (file + line) -- direct mode is not silent mode
Does not bundle unrelated cleanup or refactors with the typo fix
